newsitem.title: UK: OPEC loans $10 million to Dominican Republic - OPECN.
newsitem.headline: OPEC loans $10 million to Dominican Republic - OPECN.

text.p: The Organisation of the Petroleum Exporting Countries (OPEC) on Monday signed a $10 million loan to the the Dominican Republic, OPEC news agency OPECNA reported on Monday.
OPEC's Fund for International Development said the loan was intended to increase productivity in the agriculatural and industrial sectors through the purchase of "essential items", OPECNA reported.
It is the Fund's sixth loan to the Dominican Republic. Previous assistance includes a commodity imports programme loan, two balance of payments support loans and two project loans, OPECNA said.
